idea-plugin.name: Air Pets
idea-plugin.description:
Keep an eye on your Air agents without opening the Air tool window. Air Pets gives each session an animated companion in IntelliJ IDEA. Pets move while agents work, ask for attention when input is needed, and celebrate a result.

  • Follow session activity through badges and animations for working, waiting, review, resting, completed, and error states.
  • Click a pet to read and reply in Quick Chat using Air's native conversation view and reply composer, or open the full session in Air. Unsupported sessions offer the full Air view instead.
  • Hover over a pet for its session name, workspace, and worktree branch when available. Optionally show Air-reported cost in USD and working time observed while the project is open, not the session's historical duration.
  • Mark a completed session as done from its pet's badge or hover card. This uses Air's archive action; it does not stop an agent or approve a review.
  • Drag pets aside, turn off animation, hide names, or hide pets. Empty space around them passes clicks through to the IDE.

Companions include cats, dogs, Clippy, Kodee, Runzo, snakes, and rubber ducks. Species are assigned automatically. The overlay shows up to 12 pets from the current project and its worktrees; the status-bar menu gives access to all discovered sessions.

Choose Tools → Air Pets → Air Pets Demo Mode to try fictional sessions without running an agent. Click Pets in the status bar or right-click a pet for preferences.
